name: aidw-lint-toolchain
description: Pipeline-owned ESLint toolchain, baked into the sandbox image at /opt/aidw/lint. Never installed into a target repo -- the repo's dependency graph is NEVER touched for linting (a root devDependency install once re-resolved a workspace's peer graph and broke its build).
//: angular-eslint and eslint-plugin-vue are deliberately absent: both peer-depend on their framework's own packages and cannot install standalone. Angular/Vue repos ship their own lint config in practice, so the gate's defer-to-repo rule covers them; the config's optional() import returns null for the missing plugins.
